reviewOutcome: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS sources and the live BHUMI viewer configuration were investigated, but no qualifying Manokwari public parcel-polygon response or safe retained geometry sample was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Indonesian discovery queries were executed and recorded. BHUMI, ATLAS, official help/legal pages, current viewer HTML, and the current JavaScript bundle were fetched anonymously over TLS. The bundle exposed the parcel layer name umum:Persil and relative route /bhumigs/umum. Direct guessed WMS capabilities/GetFeatureInfo requests returned 404, and anonymous proxy probes returned 400. The authenticated getPersil/login path was not called.
cityOrLocalCustodian: ATR/BPN is evidenced as the national official viewer/operator. A Manokwari-specific first-party local registry/cadastre map or procedure was not independently evidenced; registryFound remains null.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: Viewer configuration identified a Geoserver parcel layer but no successful parcel response exposed schema, CRS, or stable native identity. No geometry was retained.
uncertainty: A relative service route may require runtime resolution or a different upstream host. A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence. Coordinates and population were preserved exactly as required.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. Only the two named Manokwari artifacts were written; no registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
